nodes.name: TeleCRM: latest 500 leads
nodes.notes: Pick your existing TeleCRM credential (Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer <Sync token>). Replace YOUR_ENTERPRISE_ID (TeleCRM › Settings › Website and API).

nodes.name: Send to dashboard
nodes.notes: Create a Header Auth credential: Name = x-push-key, Value = a CRM push key from Settings › Workspace › API keys (the key decides the workspace). Replace YOUR-DASHBOARD-ADDRESS in the URL.
